description: SQL queries should use parameterized queries instead of string concatenation to prevent SQL injection.
User input should be validated and sanitized before being used in application logic.
Avoid database calls inside loops because they can create unnecessary repeated queries.
Prefer batching or bulk database operations when processing multiple records.
Avoid System.out.println in application code and use a structured logging framework such as SLF4J.
Use descriptive variable and method names that clearly communicate intent.
Keep business logic inside service classes instead of placing complex logic directly in controllers.
Use DTOs at API boundaries instead of exposing persistence entities directly.
Never hardcode passwords API keys tokens or other secrets in source code.
Avoid unnecessary object creation and repeated computation inside frequently executed code.
